theme_overview.philosophy: Nugvio is a 'Friendly-Serious' AI Financial Coach for Indian youth. It rewards discipline, not spending. It must feel like a smart friend texting you, not a clinical bank statement.
theme_overview.anti_ai_slop_rules: No generic purple gradients, no centered glowing orbs, no 'Inter/Roboto' fonts, no generic Bootstrap-style dashboard templates. Embrace asymmetry, rich contrasting colors, and paper-like textures.
theme_overview.core_directive: Every single screen must answer 'What should the user do NEXT?' through prominent AI Nudge components.
theme_overview.theme_mode: Primary is 'Warm Paper' (light mode) with Deep Ink text. Provide a Deep Navy dark mode toggle.

colors.rules: Use brand_blue for primary actions. Use nudge_orange for AI insights/alerts. Use growth_green for positive health scores/savings. Use celebration_coral for NugPoints and Rewards.

rules.hierarchy: Headings must use Outfit with tight tracking (tracking-tighter). Body uses DM Sans (leading-relaxed).
rules.expressive_usage: Use Kalam in celebration_coral color for the 'Nudge The Youth' tagline, user milestones, and playful UI annotations (like hand-drawn arrows or notes).
rules.banned_fonts: Inter, Roboto, Space Grotesk, Open Sans.

visual_enhancers.borders_and_surfaces: Use sharp 1px borders (border-border) on cards with flat backgrounds. Avoid heavy drop shadows; prefer crisp, solid container structures.
visual_enhancers.radii: Use rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for main cards to feel friendly. Buttons should be pill-shaped (rounded-full).
visual_enhancers.textures: Add subtle noise/grain overlays to hero sections and major widgets to kill the 'digital flat' look.

component_patterns.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary uses brand_blue. Hover states must translate-y-1 and add a subtle shadow.
component_patterns.cards: Flat white (or dark navy) background, 1px border. No floating blurry shadows.
component_patterns.inputs: Solid backgrounds (bg-gray-50 in light mode, bg-slate-800 in dark mode). Never use transparent inputs.
component_patterns.nudges: A custom component for AI advice. Should look like a polished chat bubble or banner with an orange accent and an icon.

layouts_and_spacing.grid_system: Use Bento Grid for Dashboard (asymmetric, dense). Marketing pages use Tetris Grid (wide gaps, overlapping elements).
layouts_and_spacing.spacing: Generous. Use p-6, p-8, or p-12 for internal card padding to prevent text collision.
layouts_and_spacing.alignment: Left-align dense text and forms. Avoid center-aligning paragraphs or long lists.

motion_and_interactions.hover: All interactive elements must change background color and explicitly set text color on hover. E.g., hover:bg-blue-700 hover:text-white.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific transition properties (e.g., transition-transform transition-colors). Never use 'transition-all'.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Framer motion scale-up for modals, and staggered slide-ups for list items (Expenses, Debts).

screen_blueprints.Landing: Asymmetric Hero. Left: Massive Outfit heading, Kalam tagline. Right: Floating UI widgets (Health Score, Nudges) layered over each other. Deep ink text on warm paper background.
screen_blueprints.Auth: Split screen layout. Image on one side, clean JWT login/signup form on the other. Use pill buttons.
screen_blueprints.Dashboard: Bento Grid Layout. Top: Logo and a prominent 'Next Best Action' Nudge banner. Main widgets: Financial Health Score Gauge (0-100, Recharts), Cash Flow snapshot, NugPoints Wallet (Coral), AI Nudges feed.
screen_blueprints.Expenses: List view. Prominent 'Smart Add' text input at the top ('Bought coffee for 400') that auto-categorizes via AI. Tags use green/orange.
screen_blueprints.Budget_Planner: Category-wise Shadcn Progress bars. Bars turn from blue to orange to red as they approach limits.
screen_blueprints.Goal_Planner: Visual image cards (Laptop, Bike) with Recharts RadialBar progress rings showing amount saved vs target.
screen_blueprints.AI_Coach: Chat interface. Rounded bubbles. Coach responses feature a subtle orange/blue left-border to distinguish from user.
screen_blueprints.Debt_Optimizer: Split view. Table of debts + Toggle for 'Snowball' vs 'Avalanche'. Recharts LineChart visualizes the forecast payoff date.
screen_blueprints.Learn_Literacy: Gamified lesson cards. XP and Streak counters prominently displayed in Coral to celebrate learning.
screen_blueprints.Tax_Assistant: Educational step-by-step wizard. Friendly layout breaking down complex tax terms into simple English.
screen_blueprints.Cash_Flow_Predict: Recharts Area chart forecasting future balances. Includes AI warning markers on dips.
screen_blueprints.Rewards_NugPoints: Grid of redeemable vouchers. Displays current NugPoints prominently. Focus on rewarding financial discipline.

landing_hero.usage: Hero section background or auth split screen (Confident young Indian professional).

goals_education.usage: Visuals for the 'Buy a Laptop' or 'Education' in Goal Planner.

lifestyle_expenses.usage: Context image for 'Expenses' or 'Splitting bills' feature.

tech_stack_and_commands.icons: Use iconoir-react for a non-corporate, unique aesthetic. If Lucide must be used, use stroke-width 1.5 for elegance.
tech_stack_and_commands.charts: Use Recharts for all graphs (Health Score Gauge, Cash Flow Area, Debt LineChart).

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
DO NOT use generic centered layouts or simplistic purple/blue gradients.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute.
DO NOT apply 'transition: all' anywhere. This breaks framer-motion transforms.
DO NOT add '.App { text-align: center; }' in CSS.
Ensure high contrast on interactive elements. NEVER use transparent backgrounds for overlays, dropdowns, or inputs.
Always add GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Provide 2-3x padding, use clear visual hierarchy, and ensure accessible contrast ratios.
